posts.text: What does the 25th amendment do? Trump, the war in Iran and the President’s ultimatum and deadline are coming to a head.  And if you think the 25th Amendment is an easy solution, you should think again…

Should food be a human right? Food is an essential part of life. It should be a human right. The United States voted a U.N. resolution to make food a human right, and people like @Patriotic Peach celebrated that failure because they are convinced that making food a human right would require forcing people to produce it. Let’s fact check that logic.  #humanrights #foodinsecurity

During a press conference, Donald Trump said that he wants his legacy to be that of a great peacemaker. He also said that he thinks of himself as a great peacemaker.  Trump made those statements as the war against Iran continues without a clear end in sight.

Houston’s George Bush Airport opened a prayer room catering to Muslim travelers, which includes prayer rugs, a copy of the Quran, and a washing station.  Atlanta airport now offers one prayer a week for Muslim passengers.  And people like toribranum are losing their mind over this because the faith and religion does not meet their expectations.  Is this what tolerance in America looks like?

Victor J Glover, the pilot of the Artemis II, is being celebrated as the first Black American on a moon mission.  But people like @Grace Unfiltered think that we need to stop celebrating Black achievements. The reason we have to celebrate the achievements of Black Americans is because the system is designed to make it more difficult for People of Color to win or even compete in certain areas.  Equity is also about celebrating victories.

Celebrating the failure to pass a law that would have prevented cousins from marrying each other only because democratic lawmakers were in favor of it is weird, but that’s what people like @Ø₣₣ƗĆƗΔŁ MΛGΛMΣG⁴⁷👊🏻🇺🇸🦄 are doing.

Trump’s spiritual adviser, Paula White-Cain, used an Easter message to compare President Trump’s life and struggles to those of Jesus, saying that both were betrayed and both were arrested.  Paula White-Cain continued “Mr. President, no one has paid the price like you have paid the price.”
Also “too” and not “to”.  message that’s unacceptable at this day and age. Justice and equality mean nothing if we’re still sending these messages.

President Trump posted on social media that the United States is the only country that offers birthright citizenship.  That’s not true. There are dozens of countries, many of them in the americas and including Mexico and Canada, that have codified unrestricted birthright citizenship rights, regardless of the parents’ status.

During the birthright citizenship case hearing, Supreme Court Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson talked about a wallet stolen in Japan in the context of “allegiance” and what that term means, and a lot of conservative commentators, including @BraedenSorbo , ran to record videos to criticize her.
